# NYE Incident Protocol - Legacy Infrastructure Quick Fix Guide

> **Purpose**: Quick reference for fixing issues on legacy infra during NYE when response time is critical.

---

## 🎯 Production VM (VM6)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Name** | Imperial treasure OneDrive to SAP |
| **ID** | 6 |
| **IP** | `13.77.1**.245` (port 8080) |
| **Type** | Azure VM Scale Set (VMSS) |
| **Health** | http://13.77.1**.**45:8080/health |

### ⚠️ CRITICAL LIMITATION
```
azure_resource_id = NULL
→ CANNOT restart via /api/admin/machines/6/restart
→ Requires Azure Portal direct access
```

---

## 📋 Critical Workflows on VM6

| Workflow | ID | Schedule | Priority |
|----------|-----|----------|----------|
| **SAP Journal Entry** | 71 | `*/5 * * * *` (5min) | 🔴 CRITICAL |
| Count Unprocessed Files | 84 | `0 */6 * * *` (6hr) | 🟡 Medium |

---

## 🔧 Recovery Endpoints

### Force Complete All Stuck Executions
```bash
curl -X POST https://app.mediar.ai/api/admin/force-complete-all
```

### Reset Only Running → Completed  
```bash
curl -X POST https://app.mediar.ai/api/admin/reset-stuck
```

### Check Stuck Count
```bash
curl https://app.mediar.ai/api/admin/check-stuck
```

### Manual Health Check
```bash
curl "https://app.mediar.ai/api/cron/health-check-supabase?x-vercel-protection-bypass=<VERCEL_TOKEN>"
```

### Check VM6 Health Directly
```bash
curl http://13.77.1**.2**:8080/health
```

---

## 🗄️ Database Quick Fixes (Supabase)

### Check Stuck Executions
```sql
SELECT id, workflow_id, status, created_at 
FROM workflow_executions 
WHERE status IN ('running', 'queued') 
AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 min';
```

### Force Complete All Stuck
```sql
UPDATE workflow_executions 
SET status = 'completed', completed_at = NOW() 
WHERE status IN ('running', 'queued', 'cancelled');
```

### Clear Stale Locks
```sql
DELETE FROM processing_locks WHERE expires_at < NOW();
```

### Pause Workflow 71 (SAP Journal Entry)
```sql
UPDATE deployed_workflows SET cron_enabled = false WHERE id = 71;
```

### Resume Workflow 71
```sql
UPDATE deployed_workflows SET cron_enabled = true WHERE id = 71;
```

### Silence All Alerts
```sql
UPDATE notification_configs SET enabled = false;
```

### Re-enable Alerts
```sql
UPDATE notification_configs SET enabled = true;
```

---

## 🔄 Modal Executor (Legacy Python)

### Redeploy
```bash
cd modal_apps
export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8
modal deploy modal_apps/workflow_executor.py
```

### Check Logs
```bash
modal app logs workflow-executor
```

### List Running Containers
```bash
modal container list
```

---

## ☁️ Azure Portal Access (for VM6 VMSS)

Since VM6 lacks `azure_resource_id`, must use portal:

1. Go to https://portal.azure.com
2. Subscription: `5c0a60d0-92cf-****-****-b462bc2fe194`
3. Search for scale set with IP `13.77.1**.2**`
4. Or search "imperial" in resources

### Azure CLI (if you know the VMSS name)
```bash
# List scale set instances
az vmss list-instances -g <RESOURCE_GROUP> -n <VMSS_NAME>

# Restart instance
az vmss restart -g <RESOURCE_GROUP> -n <VMSS_NAME> --instance-ids <ID>
```

---

## 📧 Alert Recipients

- l]uis@mediar.ai
- m]tt@mediar.ai

---

## 📁 Key Code Locations

| Purpose | Path |
|---------|------|
| Modal Executor | `modal_apps/workflow_executor.py` |
| Cron Scheduler | `apps/web/src/app/api/cron/scheduler/route.ts` |
| Health Check | `apps/web/src/app/api/cron/health-check-supabase/route.ts` |
| Force Complete | `apps/web/src/app/api/admin/force-complete-all/route.ts` |
| Reset Stuck | `apps/web/src/app/api/admin/reset-stuck/route.ts` |
| Emergency Fix (Modal) | `modal_apps/emergency_fix.py` |

---

## 🚨 Incident Response Checklist

1. [ ] Check VM6 health: `curl http://13.77.1**.2**:8080/health`
2. [ ] Check stuck executions count
3. [ ] If queue blocked → Force complete all
4. [ ] If Modal hung → Redeploy executor
5. [ ] If VM unreachable → Azure Portal to restart VMSS
6. [ ] If need to stop workflow → Disable cron in DB
7. [ ] Notify team via alerts or direct message

---

## 📞 Escalation

If nothing works:
1. Pause all cron workflows
2. Force complete all executions  
3. Silence alerts
4. Document what happened
5. Fix properly after NYE

---

*Created: Dec 15, 2025 | For: NYE 2025-2026 coverage*

I.T. Troubleshooting:
1. Sometime the workflow fails three time in a row and stops schedule. Most of the time restarting schedule fixes the issue
2. ⁠sometimes extension disappears, just run old extension workflow from the dashboard 
3. ⁠sometimes files stop syncing in one drive, right click on it, pause, then resume
4. ⁠sometimes files stop coming in from n8n- message chai then
5. ⁠sometimes vm restarts, need to reconnect mcp, just see last cli commands that we ran
